product.title: Wines and Spirits Alec Waugh Time Life Hardcover Recipe Book Slipcase 1968
product.description:
Wines and Spirits — Alec Waugh

An illustrated guide to wines, spirits and drinks from Time-Life's Foods of the World series, with its companion spiral recipe booklet and matching slipcase.

Condition

Good used vintage condition with visible wear. Slipcase has spotting, stains, discoloration, scuffs, creases and worn edges/corners. Hardcover has surface rubbing and corner wear. Spiral recipe booklet shows cover marks and edge/corner wear. Photographed interior pages appear readable; contents have not been inspected page by page. Please review all photographs.

Details

  • Alec Waugh and the Editors of Time-Life Books
  • Foods of the World series; photographed by Arie deZanger
  • Hardcover copyright 1968; exact printing and recipe booklet date unconfirmed. No first-edition claim.
  • English-language hardcover and spiral-bound recipe booklet
  • Approximate set dimensions: 11 × 8¾ × 1½ inches; estimated, not individually measured

Included

One hardcover, one companion spiral-bound recipe booklet and the illustrated slipcase shown.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with corner and edge protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
